initial-loading: Status message shown in place of the login form while the app checks the user's login status on startup.
logged-in: Label preceding the logged-in username in the top-right header. Followed by the username.
logout: Link text in the top-right header that signs the user out.
app-language: Label for the interface language selector.
footer-tutorial: Footer link to the CropTool help/tutorial page on Wikimedia Commons.
footer-report-issues: Footer link to the GitHub issue tracker for reporting bugs.
loginform-header: Heading of the login panel shown to unauthenticated users.
loginform-blurb: Introductory paragraph in the login panel describing what CropTool2 does. Contains an HTML anchor tag. Uses the named parameter {{url}}, which is the URL of the CropTool help page on Commons.
loginform-help: Second paragraph in the login panel explaining that the user must connect their Wikimedia account via OAuth and that their password is not shared.
INVALID_COOKIE: Warning shown when the user's session cookie is no longer valid.
loginform-submit-button: Label of the submit button in the login panel that initiates the OAuth authorization flow.
titleform-header: Heading of the panel where the user enters the file they want to crop.
titleform-help: Help text in the file-entry panel explaining what to type in the input field.
titleform-file-label: Label and placeholder text for the file URL/filename input field in the file-entry panel.
titleform-submit-button: Label of the submit button in the file-entry panel that opens the selected file for cropping.
titleform-footer: Footer note in the file-entry panel with a tip about opening CropTool2 directly from a media file page. Contains an HTML anchor tag. Uses the named parameter {{url}}, which is the URL of the CropTool help page on Commons.
titleform-file-found: Inline success message shown below the filename input when the entered file is found on the wiki.
titleform-file-not-found: Inline error message shown below the filename input when the entered file is not found on the wiki.
file-waiting-for-license-review: Error message shown when the user tries to crop a file that has a pending Flickr license review. Thrown by the PHP backend (WikiPage.php) and displayed in the UI.
fetching-progress: Status message shown while the app is loading image data and metadata from the wiki after the user opens a file.
view-at-site: Link text for the link to the file's description page on the source wiki. Uses the named parameter {{site}}, which is the hostname of the wiki (e.g. "commons.wikimedia.org").
original-dimensions: Displays the original image dimensions below the crop canvas. Uses named parameters: {{width}} — width in pixels, {{height}} — height in pixels.
thumb-dimensions: Displays the thumbnail dimensions used for the crop preview. Uses named parameters: {{width}} — width in pixels, {{height}} — height in pixels.
crop-dimensions:
Shows the selected crop dimensions. Parameters:
* {{width}} - width in pixels
* {{height}} - height in pixels.
cropped-dimensions: Shows the final cropped image dimensions. Uses named parameters: {{width}} — width in pixels, {{height}} — height in pixels.
cropform-border-locator: Button label in the crop form that triggers automatic border detection to set the crop region.
cropform-orientation: Section heading for the rotate-left/rotate-right buttons in the crop form.
cropform-rotate-left: Tooltip and screen-reader label for the button that rotates the image 90° counter-clockwise.
cropform-rotate-right: Tooltip and screen-reader label for the button that rotates the image 90° clockwise.
cropform-straighten: Label for the straighten/deskew angle slider and number input in the crop form.
cropform-straighten-auto: Tooltip and screen-reader label for the button that automatically detects and applies a straighten angle.
cropform-straighten-increase: Tooltip and screen-reader label for the button that increases the straighten angle by 0.1°.
cropform-straighten-decrease: Tooltip and screen-reader label for the button that decreases the straighten angle by 0.1°.
cropform-orientation-reset: Tooltip and screen-reader label for the button that resets both rotation and straighten angle to zero.
cropform-crop: Label for the crop action. Not currently used as visible text but present as a key.
left: Label for the crop region left-offset (x) number input in the crop dimensions section.
top: Label for the crop region top-offset (y) number input in the crop dimensions section.
width: Label for the crop region width number input in the crop dimensions section.
height: Label for the crop region height number input in the crop dimensions section.
cropform-value-increase: Screen-reader label for the small stepper buttons that increase a crop dimension (left, top, width, height) or aspect-ratio field value by one step.
cropform-value-decrease: Screen-reader label for the small stepper buttons that decrease a crop dimension (left, top, width, height) or aspect-ratio field value by one step.
page: Label preceding the page-number selector shown for multi-page files (DjVu, PDF).
cropform-method: Section heading for the JPEG crop method radio buttons (Precise / Lossless).
cropform-method-precise: Radio button label for the precise JPEG crop method.
cropform-method-lossless: Radio button label for the lossless JPEG crop method.
cropform-method-precise-help: Popover tooltip explaining the precise crop method: uses the exact selection but may cause minor JPEG quality loss.
cropform-method-lossless-help: Popover tooltip explaining the lossless crop method: avoids JPEG quality loss but may include a few extra pixels.
cropform-preview-btn: Label of the submit button in the crop form that generates a crop preview.
cropform-help: Label for a help link or button in the crop form.
cropform-rotation: Label for the rotation section in the crop form.
cropform-aspect-ratio: Section heading for the aspect-ratio controls in the crop form.
cropform-aspect-ratio-keep: Aspect-ratio option that keeps the original file's ratio.
cropform-aspect-ratio-square: Aspect-ratio option for a square crop.
cropform-aspect-ratio-fixed: Aspect-ratio option for a custom fixed ratio.
cropform-adjustments: Heading for brightness, contrast, and saturation controls.
cropform-brightness: Label for the brightness slider and number input in the image adjustments section.
cropform-contrast: Label for the contrast slider and number input in the image adjustments section.
cropform-saturation: Label for the saturation slider and number input in the image adjustments section.
cropform-adjustments-auto: Button text for automatically suggesting one adjustment value.
cropform-adjustments-reset: Button text for resetting brightness, contrast, and saturation controls.
cropform-adjustments-increase: Tooltip and accessible label for increasing a brightness, contrast, or saturation value by 1.
cropform-adjustments-decrease: Tooltip and accessible label for decreasing a brightness, contrast, or saturation value by 1.
cropform-adjustments-compare-preview: Tooltip and accessible label for a button that temporarily hides live brightness, contrast, and saturation adjustments while it is held down.
cropform-aspect-ratio-values: Label for the custom aspect-ratio width:height input pair.
cropform-aspect-ratio-width: Accessible label for the aspect-ratio width number input.
cropform-aspect-ratio-height: Accessible label for the aspect-ratio height field.
cropform-aspect-ratio-lock: Tooltip for locking the aspect ratio.
cropform-aspect-ratio-unlock: Tooltip and screen-reader label for the button that unlocks (removes) the current aspect-ratio constraint.
cropping-progress: Status message shown while the server is processing the crop operation.
previewform-lossless-crop-performed: Success notice shown in the preview step when a lossless JPEG crop was completed successfully.
previewform-lossless-explanation: Additional note shown alongside the lossless success notice when the actual crop dimensions differ from the requested ones due to JPEG block alignment.
previewform-precise-crop-performed: Success notice shown in the preview step when a precise crop was performed.
previewform-overwrite-policy: Warning note shown in the preview step when the user selects the overwrite option on Wikimedia Commons. Contains an HTML anchor tag linking to COM:CROP. Uses the named parameter {{url}}, which is the URL of the Commons overwriting policy page.
previewform-overwrite-policy-help: Popover tooltip for the overwrite-policy warning note, advising to overwrite only for minor improvements.
previewform-assessment-template: Warning shown in the preview step when the original file has passed a quality assessment (e.g. Featured Picture). The overwrite radio button is disabled.
previewform-donotcrop-template: Warning shown in the preview step when the original file is tagged with a 'do not crop' or 'border is intentional' template. The overwrite radio button is disabled.
previewform-upload-protected: Warning shown in the preview step when the original file is protected against new file versions. The overwrite radio button is disabled.
previewform-rename-tip: Hint shown below the new filename input when the suggested filename has not been changed, encouraging the user to choose a more descriptive name.
previewform-multipage-file: Warning shown in the preview step when the source is a page from a multi-page file (DjVu/PDF). The overwrite radio button is disabled.
previewform-removed-border: Checkbox label in the preview step confirming that the user has removed the border. Shown only when the original file has the {{Remove border}} template.
previewform-removed-border-help: Tooltip for the 'removed border' checkbox explaining that checking it will remove the {{Remove border}} template from the file page.
previewform-trimmed: Checkbox label in the preview step confirming that the user has trimmed the image. Shown only when the original file has the {{Trimming}} template.
previewform-trimmed-help: Tooltip for the 'trimmed' checkbox explaining that checking it will remove the {{Trimming}} template from the file page.
previewform-removed-watermark: Checkbox label in the preview step confirming that the user has removed the watermark. Shown only when the original file has the {{Watermark}} template.
previewform-removed-watermark-help: Tooltip for the 'removed watermark' checkbox explaining that checking it will remove the {{Watermark}} template from the file page.
previewform-wikidata-crop: Checkbox label in the preview step for adding the cropped image as an illustration on Wikidata. Uses the named parameter {{link}}, which is an HTML link to the Wikidata item (e.g. "Cat (Q146)").
previewform-wikidata-crop-help: Tooltip for the Wikidata checkbox explaining that it will add the cropped image as the P18 (image) property of the Wikidata item.
previewform-overwrite: Radio button label in the preview step for overwriting the original file with the cropped version.
previewform-create-new: Radio button label in the preview step for uploading the cropped image as a new, separate file.
previewform-new-title: Screen-reader label for the new filename input field shown when 'Upload as new file' is selected.
previewform-metadata: Heading for the metadata section (depicts statements and categories) shown when uploading as a new file.
previewform-depicts: Sub-heading for the list of Wikidata 'depicts' (P180) statements that can be copied to the new file.
previewform-categories: Sub-heading for the list of Commons categories that can be copied to the new file.
previewform-new-title-exists: Inline warning shown when the entered new filename already exists on the wiki.
previewform-new-title-exists-confirm-ove: Label for the checkbox/button that confirms the user wants to overwrite the existing file with the new filename.
previewform-new-title-exists-overwrite-w: Warning shown alongside the filename conflict notice. Contains an HTML anchor tag linking to COM:CROP. Uses the named parameter {{url}}, which is the URL of the Commons overwriting policy page.
previewform-upload-comment: Label for the upload comment textarea in the preview step.
previewform-back-btn: Label of the Back button in the preview step that returns the user to the crop selection step.
previewform-upload-btn: Label of the Upload submit button in the preview step.
upload-progress: Status message shown while the cropped image is being uploaded to the wiki.
results-success: Bold success heading shown in the upload result card after a successful upload.
results-success-details: Detailed success message shown after a successful upload with a link to review the result. Contains an HTML anchor tag. Uses the named parameter {{url}}, which is the URL of the uploaded file's description page.
results-success-details-short: Short link text shown in the upload result card below the success heading, linking to the uploaded file's description page.
results-copy-filename: Label for the filename copy field in the upload result card.
results-copy-url: Label for the file URL copy field in the upload result card.
results-copy: Button label for copying a value (filename or URL) to the clipboard in the upload result card.
results-copied: Button label shown briefly after a value has been successfully copied to the clipboard.
results-copy-success: Screen-reader live-region announcement confirming that a value was copied to the clipboard.
results-success-wikidata: Info note shown after a successful upload when the image was also added to a Wikidata item. Uses the named parameter {{link}}, which is an HTML link to the Wikidata item.
results-failure: Error message shown when the upload fails. Uses the named parameter {{error}}, which is the error message returned by the MediaWiki API.
